import json, resource, subprocess, sys
def peak(script):
    p = subprocess.run(['python3','-c',script], capture_output=True)
    return p.stdout.decode().strip(), p.stderr.decode()[-200:]
shapes = {
 'lists': b'{"version":1,"zz":[' + b'[],' * 2790000 + b'[]]}',
 'dicts': b'{"version":1,"zz":[' + b'{},' * 2790000 + b'{}]}',
 'nested2': b'{"version":1,"zz":[' + b'[[]],' * 1390000 + b'[[]]]}',
 'ints': b'{"version":1,"zz":[' + b'0,' * 1600000 + b'0]}',
 'strings': b'{"version":1,"zz":[' + b'"ab",' * 1670000 + b'"ab"]}',
}
code = '''
import json, resource, sys
data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
obj = json.loads(data)
print("%.1f" % (resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024.0))
'''
for name, payload in shapes.items():
    p = subprocess.run(['python3','-c',code], input=payload, capture_output=True)
    print('%-8s bytes=%d peak=%s MiB' % (name, len(payload), p.stdout.decode().strip()))
PYEOF
